newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.04 rupees up at 41.17 to the dollar on Tuesday in the kerb amid high supply of the U.S. currency and dealers said the rupee might rise further on Wednesday.
"The supply of dollar is much above its demand," dealer Owais Kalia said adding that a persistent shortage of rupees was likely to further strengthen the local currency.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on forex bearer certificates closed at 2.80 percent, down from its previous 2.90 percent close. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
